required_case_registry.required_outcome: Static form has no Tab stop or action. Clickable form activates once. Metadata clips by cells. Two brands remain independent.
Enter/Space and completed click activate once. Release outside cancels. Busy/loading/disabled refuse activation. Slots keep action and focus geometry.
Checked and mixed states remain distinct. Space toggles. Read-only and disabled rules hold. Chosen mark remains distinct from focus.
On/off changes once per activation. Label and mark agree. Hover and press do not change the committed value.
One chosen value; declared arrow-selection policy; disabled option skip; stable value on reorder; focus and choice stay distinct.
Single/multiple selection policies; disabled chips; overflow; cursor versus selected set; pointer and key parity.
Label, help, error, required mark, and child align. Error text remains reachable. Wrapper preserves the child identity and edit behavior.
Grapheme edit, cell cursor, SelectAll/CaretEnd, validation, commit/cancel/blur, undo/redo, secret policy, copy-before-quit.
Multi-line selection, wrap, vertical/horizontal scroll, newline policy, paste, undo/redo, and cursor reveal survive resize.
Open/commit/cancel; owner focus; popup row fill; empty/disabled options; placement clamp; outside dismiss; choice survives reorder.
First-error focus; grouped layout; optional fields; submit validation; atomic commit; dirty leave; long error and narrow form reachability.
Stable keyed cursor/selection/anchor; wheel does not move focus; selectable-only SelectAll; row metadata; empty and virtualized rows.
Query owns text and shortcuts; Unicode matching policy; zero results; hidden chosen item policy; query clear and focus restore.
Route choice distinct from cursor; badges and overflow; current route reveal; collapsed/expanded presentation; disabled destinations.
Parent/leaf actions; branch key/click policies; expansion identity; filtered ancestors; stable cursor after removal; scroll/reveal.
Current/completed/error/disabled states; forward/back rules; compact labels; overflow reveal; stable step identity.
Chosen tab versus focus; arrow policy; disabled skip; long-title overflow; neutral covered selection; content focus transition.
Search, caller-ranked items, disabled item, no results, preview, commit/cancel, modal trap, and owner restoration.
CommandPalette is a type alias for Picker; verify alias semantics and do not count an independent implementation.
Forward/back chain; retained prior state; cancel at each depth; no background action leak. Test stale responses only for an existing async adapter.
Owner-focused fill; candidate/detail views; accept/cancel; stale revision rejection; placement; editor cursor and focus preserved.
Safe initial action; Tab/BackTab wrap; nested modal; Esc/outside policy resolves cancel; validation; owner restoration; narrow body scroll.
Test this descriptor through MenuBar and ContextMenu. Check separators, disabled entries, submenu actions, stable identity, and dismissal.
Right-click selected row keeps multi-selection. Unselected row becomes context. Clamp placement. Resolve current action at dispatch.
Keyboard menu switching; hover-switch override; submenu restoration; Escape depth; inactive/covered styling; terminal-valid hints.
